Elena G.: Quick async -- noticed a broken fragment in ops/runbooks/scale-workers when following the 'tuning' link from the autoscale guide: https://kb.internal/ops/runbooks/scale-workers#tuning previews page but jumps to top (fragment not found). Can someone grab a tiny fix?
link-checker-bot: Scan alert: header changed in ops/runbooks/scale-workers.md. Old anchor '#tuning' missing; current H3 text 'Tuning parameters (beta)' produces id '#tuning-parameters-beta'. Recommendation: add explicit id or a short alias in frontmatter to preserve legacy fragments.
Marcos V.: I can do a minimal patch. Adding an explicit id keeps visible heading unchanged: `### Tuning parameters (beta) {#tuning}`.
Samira L.: Happy to CR. Also would be good to run a repo search for other references to the old fragment: `rg "scale-workers#tuning" -n --hidden`.
Elena G.: I'll run the ripgrep and attach results. Plan: small PR with header id + changelog entry + ripgrep output, tag @eng-runbooks in PR description. Any objections?
eng-runbooks-bot: Note: codeowners for /ops/runbooks are '@eng-runbooks' and '@sre-oncall'. Owners-approval required for merge if CODEOWNERS matches.
Marcos V.: FYI perl one-liner I used to locally insert id: `perl -0777 -pe "s/### Tuning parameters \(beta\)(?!\s*\{)/### Tuning parameters (beta) {#tuning}/s" -i ops/runbooks/scale-workers.md`
Samira L.: Quick review offer: ping me the PR link and I'll do a fast CR once owners tag is present.
Elena G.: Opening PR in ~8m with rg output and owners tag. Leaving Marcos to shepherd. Thanks everyone :rocket:
